name: Alchemy
title: Potion-only profession required for Pathway advancement
summary: Alchemy is separate from equipment Item Creation and Enchanting. Every character must learn it before Pathway-stage advancement, and every transition requires the correct Alchemy-brewed potion. Brewing takes six world ticks and includes a mini-game; the timing interaction and detailed outcomes remain open.
scenarioNote: A correct advancement potion grants its target stage deterministically; no brewing scenario is authored yet.

points.text: Alchemy is a separate potion-only profession required before Pathway-stage advancement; formula decoding, ingredient identification/search/gathering, and brewing are its approved capability areas.
Every Pathway transition requires the correct potion; consuming it grants the target stage deterministically.
Potion brewing takes six world-time ticks and includes a mini-game; how that mini-game interacts with the shared clock remains open.

gaps: Learning and skill progression, ability unlocks, formula/ingredient discovery, mini-game and failure outcomes, potion categories, V1 inclusion, and numeric balance remain open.
